Tasks.Prompt: A point C is not on line m. Construct a perpendicular through C and a parallel through C, without directly drawing the final answer freehand. Name the circle centred C, two points A,B cut on m, their second equidistant intersection D, then perform a second perpendicular through C. A partner checks your labels and reasons.

Criteria.Criterion: Positive circle opening strictly greater than distance C-to-m, so A,B distinct
Correct bisector of chord AB through C and right-angle explanation
Second perpendicular specifically through C produces parallel to m
Reproducible written tool steps, all labels and partner check

Tasks.Accept: Any tool-valid equivalent path with actual labelled drawing, peer check, perpendicular/parallel mathematical justifications
Tasks.Reject: Tangent single intersection, mislocated through-C condition, scalar answer only

Tasks.Prompt: For C off m, construct a mirror point C' on the other side of m so m is perpendicular bisector of CC'. Name foot F, explain CF=FC' and the right angle, then identify the reflection.

Criteria.Criterion: Correct perpendicular through C to m with labelled foot F
Constructs C' across m with CF=FC' on same perpendicular
Labels right angle and midpoint F, justifies m as perpendicular bisector
Correctly describes reflection C->C' as distance-preserving and draws teacher-checkable figure

Tasks.Accept: Either orientation and any nonzero C-to-m distance; real paper figure and explanation
Tasks.Reject: Reflecting along m, no equal-distance justification or online attachment claim

Items.Prompt: Given line AB and C off it, explain why constructing a perpendicular bisector of an auxiliary chord of AB is useful for a perpendicular line through C.
Items.Expected: A circle centred C cutting AB at two points E,F gives CE=CF; C belongs to perpendicular bisector of EF, which is perpendicular to AB.

Items.Prompt: If distinct lines l and m are both perpendicular to transversal n in the same plane, which are true: l||m, l perpendicular m, l perpendicular n, m perpendicular n?
Items.Expected: l||m, l perpendicular n, m perpendicular n; l not perpendicular m.

Items.Prompt: Describe how to bisect a non-straight angle ABC by equal-distance marks on the rays and equal-radius intersecting arcs.
Items.Expected: Choose P on BA and Q on BC with BP=BQ; arcs centred P and Q same opening meet at interior X, draw BX, argue SSS for congruent angles.

Items.Prompt: Let A,C,B lie on line in that order with AC=CB. Circles centred A,B equal radius r>AB/2 intersect X,Y. What equals AX and BX?
Items.Expected: AX=BX=r; XY passes through C perpendicular AB.

Items.Prompt: In a regular hexagon radius r centred O, why is triangle OAB for consecutive vertices A,B equilateral, while ACE for alternate vertices is also equilateral?
Items.Expected: OA=OB=AB=r by hexagon construction; ACE spans equal 120-degree central arcs, so AC=CE=EA.

Items.Prompt: Circles centred A and B each radius AB intersect at X,Y. Name all four segments AX,BX,AY,BY in relation to AB.
Items.Expected: Each equals AB by circle membership.

Items.Prompt: Given A=(−3,0), B=(3,0), X=(0,4), Y=(0,−4), identify a perpendicular pair and two congruent segments.
Items.Expected: Line XY is perpendicular to AB; XA=XB=5 (also YA=YB=5).

Items.Prompt: Two equal radius-r circles centred A,B pass through each other's centres. Their intersection X is marked. Which of AX, BX and AB are equal?
Items.Expected: All equal r; triangle ABX equilateral.

CCourseContract.PaperDelivery: Student submits labelled exterior-point perpendicular and parallel compass constructions plus proof to school teacher. Teacher checks physical evidence, assigns 0/1/2 each rubric dimension, writes feedback and signs/dates paper; no online submission or grade asserted.

Cases.CORRECT: circle radius > distance C-to-m gives two intersections; both perpendiculars and parallel through C proven
Cases.EQUIVALENT: rotated/reflected valid diagram and alternate admissible radius
Cases.WRONG: tangent circle with one intersection or line not through C
Cases.INSUFFICIENT: numeric answer or unlabeled sketch only
Cases.MALFORMED: C not off m as required or undefined circle
